title: Which Way to the Station
label: ch:ja-which-way-to-the-station
canDo: I can ask the way (eki wa doko desu ka; kūkō made dō yatte ikimasu ka), follow directions (massugu itte, migi ni magatte kudasai), buy tickets with the counter mai, and ask when the next train leaves.

payoff.summary: Complete JA-R256-which-way-to-the-station: ask the way, buy two tickets and ask when the train leaves.
